title: Design System: Teacher Diego Essay Writing Desk

display.purpose: Page title only, one per screen.

title.purpose: Part names, whole-paragraph heading, circled level word.

title-small.purpose: In-sheet h3s on the marked sheet.

body-writing.purpose: Student text and read-back on the 28px grid.

label.purpose: Keys for single items, sentence case, never eyebrows.

figures.purpose: Counts, ranges and points in tabular mono; unit words stay in body.

score.purpose: Circled points on the marked sheet.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Every sheet; the only elevated surface.

shadows.name: mark-button-hover
shadows.purpose: Mark button on hover, with a 1px lift and pen-red fill.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Writing-area focus halo in the role highlighter.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrances, swipes, mode-switch thumb, tally fill, bottom bar slide.

motion.name: hl-swipe
motion.purpose: Highlighter swipe left to right; read-back segments stagger 260ms.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animations off, pen strokes fully drawn, transitions 0.01ms

components.name: Mark Button
components.description: The single primary action: get the paragraph marked. Navy at rest, pen red on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--ink, #1c2533); color: var(--paper, #fdfdfe); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -6px rgba(28,37,51,0.45); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms, box-shadow 200ms, background-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-mark:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: var(--pen, #c0392b); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -10px rgba(192,57,43,0.6); } .ds-btn-mark:active { transform: none; } .ds-btn-mark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pen, #c0392b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as Check coherence and Use all suggested edits.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #1c2533); border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1c2533); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--ink, #1c2533); color: var(--paper, #fdfdfe); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pen, #c0392b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: See Your Marking Button
components.description: Replaces the Mark button in the phone bar once the current text is marked; carries the points in pen mono.
components.css: .ds-btn-see { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #1c2533); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--paper, #fdfdfe); color: var(--ink, #1c2533); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-see:hover { background: var(--ink, #1c2533); color: var(--paper, #fdfdfe); } .ds-btn-see:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pen, #c0392b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pts { font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--pen, #c0392b); } .ds-pts small { font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Writing Area
components.description: Squared-paper textarea on the 28px grid; focus takes the role ink and highlighter halo.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-writing" rows="3" style="--part-ink:#1f4e79; --hl:rgba(110,175,240,0.45)" placeholder="Online classes save students time and money."></textarea>
components.css: .ds-writing { display: block; width: 100%; resize: none; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(28,37,51,0.14)); border-radius: 4px; background-color: var(--paper, #fdfdfe); background-image: linear-gradient(var(--grid-line, rgba(31,78,121,0.085)) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid-line, rgba(31,78,121,0.085)) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 28px 28px; background-position: -1px -1px; background-attachment: local; color: var(--ink, #1c2533); caret-color: var(--pen, #c0392b); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 28px; transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-writing::placeholder { color: var(--ink-faint, #6b7686); } .ds-writing:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--part-ink, #1c2533); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--hl, rgba(28,37,51,0.14)); }

components.name: Section Navigation
components.description: Wordmark plus five section links with status; active link gets a drawn red underline.
components.html: Teacher Diego Argumentative essayIntroduction 0.8Body 1 Body 2
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--ink, #1c2533); } .ds-wordmark small { font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--ink-faint, #6b7686); margin-left: 8px; } .ds-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a5568); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 4px; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--ink, #1c2533); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pen, #c0392b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-active { color: var(--ink, #1c2533); font-weight: 700; } .ds-link b { font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: var(--pen, #c0392b); } .ds-link i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink-faint, #6b7686); align-self: center; } .ds-link svg { position: absolute; left: 8px; bottom: -2px; width: calc(100% - 16px); height: 8px; color: var(--pen, #c0392b); }

components.name: Role Highlighter
components.description: The highlighter swipe keyed by part role; the same colour means the same job across the essay.
components.html: Hook Claim Evidence Warrant Conclusion
components.css: .ds-hl-row { font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 28px; color: var(--ink, #1c2533); } .ds-hl { background-image: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 0, var(--hl) 0.15em, var(--hl) calc(100% - 0.1em), transparent 100%); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: 100% 78%; background-position: 0 60%; -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; box-decoration-break: clone; border-radius: 0.2em 0.35em 0.25em 0.3em; padding: 0 0.08em; }

components.name: Circled Level
components.description: One official rubric level per paragraph: points circled in red pen, level word beneath.
components.html: 0.8/1.0Good
components.css: .ds-level { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 24px; color: var(--pen, #c0392b); } .ds-circle { position: relative; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; } .ds-circle svg { position: absolute; left: -22%; top: -30%; width: 144%; height: 160%; overflow: visible; } .ds-points { position: relative; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-points small { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-level-word { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; }

components.css: .ds-criteria { border-collapse: collapse; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink, #1c2533); min-width: 280px; } .ds-criteria tr { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(28,37,51,0.14)); } .ds-criteria tr:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-criteria th { text-align: left; font-weight: 700; padding: 10px 12px 10px 0; } .ds-criteria td { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-criteria b { color: var(--pen, #c0392b); } .ds-mark { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--pen, #c0392b); vertical-align: middle; }

components.css: .ds-note { display: flex; gap: 12px; max-width: 300px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-bracket { width: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; border: 1.4px solid var(--pen, #c0392b); border-right: 0; border-radius: 8px 0 0 8px; } .ds-key { margin: 4px 0 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--part-ink); } .ds-key span { background: var(--hl); padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 0.2em 0.35em 0.25em 0.3em; } .ds-fix { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; } .ds-fix s { color: var(--ink-soft, #4a5568); text-decoration-color: var(--pen, #c0392b); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-fix b { color: var(--pen, #c0392b); }

components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; background-color: var(--paper, #fdfdfe); background-image: linear-gradient(var(--grid-line, rgba(31,78,121,0.085)) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid-line, rgba(31,78,121,0.085)) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 28px 28px; background-position: -1px -1px; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28,37,51,0.06), 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(28,37,51,0.18); padding: 28px 28px 28px 72px; color: var(--ink, #1c2533); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 28px; } .ds-sheet::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 48px; width: 1px; background: var(--margin-rule, rgba(214,69,65,0.55)); } .ds-sheet h3 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-sheet p { margin: 8px 0 0; }

narrative.overview:
This is the same world as Diego's sibling app Response Paragraph, carried over to the five sections of an argumentative essay (introduction, two body paragraphs, counter-argument, conclusion). Each section is written on a sheet of squared paper lying on a pale blue-grey desk. The student writes in ballpoint navy, each part of the paragraph is swiped with the highlighter of the job it does, and the marking comes back in red pen: the rubric level circled first, ticks, half-ticks and crosses beside the criteria, bracketed notes in the margin. The sheet is the interface; a red margin rule divides the margin (word tally, Mark button, coherence check, circled level) from the writing.

Density is classroom-practical: text sits on a 28px grid, helper text runs at 12-14px, and every figure is set in tabular mono so counts and points read like a tally. This build is light only, classroom daylight on white paper: there are no dark tokens and no theme toggle. The world uses no texture, no handwriting fonts and no page curl; its only hand-made gestures are SVG pen strokes and the highlighter swipe.

Deliberate differences from the sibling: the four part highlighters became five and are keyed by part role rather than by paragraph part, so the same colour means the same job across all five sections (the thesis and its restatement are both blue); the marked sheet carries one official rubric level per paragraph (circled points plus a level word) instead of per-part scores; criteria rows gain a half-tick for partial credit; and the phone bottom bar changes its action once the text is marked.
keyCharacteristics: Squared paper sheets (28px grid) with a red vertical margin rule, floating on a flat desk colour.
Navy ink for all text and primary actions; red pen reserved for marking, points, errors and focus.
Five role highlighters (opening, position, support, reasoning, closing), each paired with a darker role ink.
Tabular mono for figures only; unit words stay in the body face.
Motion that imitates marking: swipes, pen strokes drawn on, notes inked in, staggered.

rules.name: The Red Pen Rule
rules.body: Red means the teacher touched it: points, corrections, errors, warnings, focus. Never use pen red for decoration, branding or a neutral call to action at rest.

rules.name: The Role Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Each highlighter belongs to a part role, set by `data-role`, which supplies both `--hl` and `--part-ink`. A role keeps the same colour in every section, and a highlighter only sits behind text that belongs to, or names, a part of its role. The one standing exception is the page title's "Get it marked." swipe (and text selection), which uses reasoning orange, as in the sibling.

rules.name: The Role Ink Rule
rules.body: Text that names a part is coloured with its role ink, never with the translucent highlighter, which is only ever a background.

rules.name: The Tally Rule
rules.body: Every count, range and score figure is set in Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono with tabular figures (`.nums`). Unit words around them ("words", "of", "of 5 points") stay in the body face, usually ink-faint.

rules.name: The On-Grid Rule
rules.body: Writing and read-back text uses a line-height equal to the grid (28px) so lines sit on the squares.

rules.name: The One Sheet Shadow Rule
rules.body: Paper is the only surface with elevation. Boxes inside a sheet stay flat and use rule-colour hairlines or a dashed rule border.

dos: Do put every content area on a sheet (paper, 28px grid, 4px corners, the sheet shadow) over the desk colour.
Do keep the margin rule at 212px with content at 236px on any sheet with a margin column, and move it to 16px below 1024px.
Do colour a part by setting `data-role` to its job (opening, position, support, reasoning, closing) and letting it supply both the highlighter and the role ink.
Do set every figure in the mono face with tabular figures, and leave unit words in the body face.
Do lead any marking with one circled rubric level per paragraph, and mark criteria with a tick (5/5), half-tick (3-4/5) or cross (0-2/5).
Do draw marking (circles, ticks, crosses, underlines, brackets) as SVG pen strokes in pen red, drawn on with `pen-draw` and staggered.
Do use expo-out (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) for entrances and swipes, and turn all of it off under reduced motion, leaving pen strokes fully drawn.
Do show corrections as a 2px red strike-through on the wrong text followed by the fix in semibold red.
donts: Don't use pen red at rest for anything that is not marking, an error, focus, or a hover response.
Don't put a role highlighter on text that does not belong to, or name, a part of that role (the page-title swipe is the one exception).
Don't add dark-theme tokens or a theme toggle to this app; it is light only.
Don't add paper texture, handwriting or script fonts, or page-curl effects; the pen exists only in SVG strokes.
Don't nest shadowed cards inside a sheet; separate with rule-colour hairlines.
Don't round controls beyond 4px or use pill buttons.
Don't set small uppercase tracked labels above a heading or section as an eyebrow; the label role is for keying individual items only.
